item.description:

Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in embedding LaCl3 nanocrystals within an amorphous Li–Al–O–Cl matrix, creating a composite electrolyte that combines high ionic conductivity (>1 mS cm–1) with exceptional thermal stability (solid at 150 °C, where baseline LAOC melts). This enables stable ASSB operation at 80 °C, unlike LAOC cells. The strategy of reinforcing a soft amorphous matrix with a rigid crystalline phase offers a cost-effective pathway for thermally robust, high-performance solid-state electrolytes.

item.title: Thiourea-Based Porous Organic Polymer/Carbon Nanotubes Interlayer for the Entrapment of Lithium Polysulfides in Lithium-Sulfur Batteries
item.description:
این مقاله یک لایه میانی از پلیمر آلی متخلخل تیواوره/نانولوله کربنی برای به دام انداختن پلی‌سولفیدهای لیتیوم در باتری‌های لیتیوم-گوگرد معرفی می‌کند.
Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in combining a thiourea-based porous organic polymer with carbon nanotubes as an interlayer, exploiting thiourea groups to chemically entrap lithium polysulfides. This addresses the shuttle effect, a key barrier to Li-S commercialization. The significance is enhanced sulfur utilization and cycling stability, offering a low-cost, earth-abundant route toward practical high-energy Li-S batteries.
🏷 lithium-sulfur battery · thiourea porous organic polymer · carbon nanotube interlayer · lithium polysulfide · shuttle effect

item.title: Effect of Cation and Cosolvent on the Solvation Nanostructure, Ion Transport, and Interfacial Kinetics in Ionic Liquid Electrolytes
item.description:
این مقاله اثر کاتیون و هم‌حلال را بر ساختار حلال‌پوشی، انتقال یون و سینتیک سطح مشترک در الکترولیت‌های مایع یونی برای باتری لیتیوم-فلز بررسی می‌کند.
Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This study reveals how cation chemistry and cosolvent choice govern solvation nanostructure, ion transport, and interfacial kinetics in ionic liquid electrolytes—an underexplored fundamental gap. By linking molecular-level solvation organization to macroscopic transport and interfacial behavior, it provides design principles for high-voltage lithium metal batteries, enabling rational electrolyte engineering beyond empirical trial-and-error approaches.
🏷 ionic liquid electrolyte · lithium metal battery · solvation structure · ion transport · interfacial kinetics

item.title: Experimental validation of universal machine learning interatomic potentials for lithium-ion dynamics in solid electrolytes via 7 Li NMR
item.description:

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in experimentally validating universal machine learning interatomic potentials using 7Li NMR to assess lithium-ion dynamics in solid electrolytes. Its significance is enabling accurate, large-scale simulations of ion transport that overcome the high computational cost of quantum methods, bridging simulation and experiment to advance solid-state battery design.
🏷 solid electrolyte · machine learning potential · Li-ion dynamics · 7Li NMR · ion transport
